title: AI Models for Depressive Disorder Detection and Diagnosis: A Review

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying bias in EEG-based depression classification using fairness metrics (e.g., statistical parity, equal opportunity, equalized odds, and equal accuracy), and assessing performance disparities in Large Language Models using datasets stratified by gender.
Assessing performance disparities in pre-trained Large Language Models evaluated on both balanced and unbalanced datasets stratified by age.
Evaluating the impact of language differences on model performance and accuracy using multilingual datasets (e.g., English, Spanish, Dutch) for depression classification.
